newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pinault-Printemps stock rises on sales.
newsitem.headline: Pinault-Printemps stock rises on sales.

text.p: Shares in retail group Pinault-Printemps-Redoute rose sharply on Friday, boosted by a rise in its January-May sales announced at the annual general meeting on Thursday, brokers said.
The stock was up 3.82 percent at 2,638 francs at 1131 GMT, outperforming the bourse's blue-chip CAC-40 index which was 0.8 percent higher.
The company said January-May sales were up 7.6 percent, or six percent higher at constant exchange rates.

Meeschaert Rousselle analyst Karine Godichaud put out a strong buy recommendation with a share price objective of 2,900-3,000 francs by year's end, citing good growth prospects for the group based on plans for new outlet openings.
Emmanuel de Thollon Pommerol at Oddo Bourse said he may revise his 1997 earnings estimates upward.
The sector has been a strong gainer since the Socialists' parliamentary election victory, seen as positive for the consumer goods, retailing, food and public works sectors.
